listed_sector_signals.signal: Refining/petrochemical plants listed as typical energy-consuming activities in the oil and gas industry (table reference, not the paper's own application context)
Passing mention that oil and gas used by the industry is transformed into electricity and heat especially in refineries
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Some of the oil and gas used directly by the industry is
transformed into electricity and heat, especially in the case of refineries and other large facilities.

listed_sector_signals.signal: Crude oil (ADCO's product) is transferred to shipping terminals and oil refineries — refineries are downstream recipients, not the paper's operation
listed_sector_signals.quote: Crude Oil: the main product of ADCO – is transferred to the shipping Terminals and oil refineries.

one_line: The paper describes ADCO's implementation and ISO 50001 accreditation of an energy management system across its upstream onshore oil and gas production operations (extraction, gas/water injection, pumping, compression); refineries/petrochemical plants are only referenced generically as industry activities and as downstream recipients of ADCO's crude.
